# tenure question

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:tenureQuestion`](gmeow-tenureQuestion.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/tenureQuestion>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/inquiry`](../../slices/inquiry.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The question the tenure records the agent as holding open over its interval. Functional: one tenure, one question; an agent holding five questions open bears five tenures. Sharing is at the [`Question`](../classes/gmeow-Question.md): two agents inquiring into the same question hold distinct tenures pointing at one [`Question`](../classes/gmeow-Question.md) individual.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:InquiryTenure`](../classes/gmeow-InquiryTenure.md) -> [`gmeow:Question`](../classes/gmeow-Question.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:tenureQuestion`](gmeow-tenureQuestion.md) from [`gmeow:InquiryTenure`](../classes/gmeow-InquiryTenure.md) to [`gmeow:Question`](../classes/gmeow-Question.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:InquiryTenure`](../classes/gmeow-InquiryTenure.md), [`gmeow:Question`](../classes/gmeow-Question.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to bind a [`gmeow:InquiryTenure`](../classes/gmeow-InquiryTenure.md) to the single [`gmeow:Question`](../classes/gmeow-Question.md) whose holding-open over the interval it records.

### Avoid when

- Avoid pointing one tenure at several questions (it is functional — five open questions are five tenures) and avoid duplicating the [`Question`](../classes/gmeow-Question.md) per agent; sharing happens at one [`Question`](../classes/gmeow-Question.md) individual.

### How to use

- Point the tenure at exactly one [`gmeow:Question`](../classes/gmeow-Question.md); open and close the surrounding [`gmeow:duringInterval`](gmeow-duringInterval.md) to record the inquiry's lifecycle rather than mutating or deleting it ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)).
